messages:
sam: Quick sync  product asked for per-role quota breakdowns in the route dashboard. Current queries explode when roles are high-cardinality.

anya: We saw this in staging. Grouping by role returns thousands of series; the query times out.

min: Short-term: add an estimator endpoint that returns expected cardinality and cost before running the full query. UI can show a warning and require confirmation.

dave: Long-term: produce a compact role_key (role_hash) in the telemetry pipeline and maintain minute-bucket rollups to make joins cheap.

sam: Agreed. Also force a max cardinality server-side (e.g., 500 groups) and return partial results with a note. Better than timeouts.

anya: UX: show "Top 500 roles (of ~3200)" and a CTA "Refine by role or sample results". Keep default grouping off for saved dashboards.

telemetry-bot: note: estimator endpoint implemented in staging: POST /insights/estimate -> {estimated_groups, est_time_ms}.

min: I'll add the estimate call in the console flow and the confirm modal. Also adding a sample parameter for analysts.

sam: Rollout: feature-flag the estimator + limit for 5 canary tenants, monitor `insights.estimate_accuracy` and `query.timeout_rate`.

dave: I'll start the pipeline PR for role_hash rollups; ETA next week.

anya: Thanks all. Let's avoid exposing raw role JSON in telemetry. role_hash only.
